question: Does delayed utility-weighted causal spectral memory improve out-of-time predictive log score under equal information and declared resource budgets?
protected_boundary: Must be assigned to an untouched chronological tail in config before inspecting outcomes; final values are frozen with data and code hashes.

default_seed_policy.interpretation: Optimization randomness, not independent financial histories

statistical_unit: A decision date with all contemporaneous assets retained together

statistics.method: paired circular moving-date-block percentile interval with a centered-bootstrap null test
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction for predeclared secondary mechanism family
statistics.seed_aggregation: Average complete predeclared seeds per observation, repeated observations per UTC date and asset, assets equally per date, then dates equally; incomplete seed families are not silently dropped

decision_rule.supported: Valid paired 95% interval for control NLL minus candidate NLL is entirely above 0.01 nats per observation, with completed declared seeds and no integrity defect
decision_rule.mixed: A predefined secondary setting improves but the primary claim does not meet its threshold; scope must be narrowed explicitly
decision_rule.negative: Valid interval upper endpoint is at or below zero
decision_rule.inconclusive: All other valid outcomes or missing planned evidence
decision_rule.invalid: Leakage, broken metric/baseline, split violation, corrupted data, or protocol mismatch

secondary_endpoints: net certainty equivalent from a nonoverlapping realizable ledger

data_efficiency.policy: Use chronological suffixes of training segment only; keep validation and protected endpoints fixed; every model receives identical data

robustness.corruption_scope: Evaluation inputs only, features scaled by train-only statistics; labels unchanged

ood: predeclared chronological crisis/recovery intervals with real-time macro vintages
compute_control: Identical information, search-trial budget and early-stopping rules; report actual gradient steps, parameters, wall time and memory. A method that needs more compute does not earn an efficiency claim merely by winning predictive score.
stopping: No protected retries to obtain a favorable result; valid negative results are terminal for this version. Failed and invalid executions remain in the evidence ledger.
